svg.title: Use an appropriate response route
svg.desc: Illustration labels: Publisher; Fictional online post; About an identifiable person; Other readers; Consider context, required harm, legal tests and possible defences.; Use appropriate support or advice; do not repeat real allegations.. Concern: Record the issue without spreading the allegation. Support: Seek appropriate trusted or specialist help. Response: Consider correction/removal or legal routes as relevant

g.text: Consider context, required harm, legal tests and possible defences.
Use appropriate support or advice; do not repeat real allegations.
